sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navneet Kumar For the Petitioner : Mr. Baibhaw Gahlaut,
Advocate For the State : Mr. Fahad Alam, A.P.P. 06/14.06.2024
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. on behalf of the State.

2. Petitioner seeks protection in terms of Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Lohsinghna P.S. Case No. 168 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 376 of the IPC, pending in the court of learned A.C.J.M., Hazaribag.

3. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the victim is a 22 years old woman and she alleged that she was having love affairs with this petitioner and she established physical relationship with him under the promise of marriage as given by the petitioner.
It is further alleged that when the petitioner refused to marry then the case was lodged.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that it is pure case of consensual physical relationship between two major parties and victim is an adult woman aged 22 years, which is an undisputed fact, as evident from the F.I.R itself.

It has further been submitted that this F.I.R has been instituted after a gap of long period of time of 5 months when the prosecutrix got her pregnancy aborted after continuously establishing physical relationship with this petitioner.
It is further submitted that petitioner has no criminal antecedent and statement to that effect has been made at para 8 of the petition.
It is further submitted on behalf of the petitioner that petitioner is ready to cooperate in the investigation and the trial.

4. On the other hand learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the contentions raised by learned counsel for the petitioner and submitted that it is a case of committing rape on the promise of marriage and the victim was forcibly administered medicine for getting her pregnancy aborted,
the learned A.P.P. does not dispute the fact that the victim is aged 22 years as is evident from the F.I.R itself.
Therefore, the petitioner does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.
5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties, perused the record of the case.
6. In view of the forceful submission advanced on behalf of the petitioner, it is found just and proper to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender in the court below within a period of 10 days and in the event of his surrender or arrest, he shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M. Hazaribag in connection with Lohsinghna P.S. Case No. 168 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down u/s 438(2) Cr.P.C. and further subject to the condition that petitioner shall cooperate in the investigation and appear before the Investigating Officer/ Trial Court as and when required during pendency of this case, failing which, appropriate order shall be passed for cancellation of his bail by the learned court below.
(Navneet Kumar, J.) A.Mohanty Manish Kumar @ Manish Kumar Paswan vs The State Of Jharkhand --- --- Opposite ... on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36045093/
